headline: USD/JPY whipsaws on soft NFP report as JPY continues to erase intervention gains. What's next?
summary: USD/JPY swung after a soft US jobs report, and rate-cut expectations partly reversed. The yen remains exposed to intervention risk and BoJ tightening expectations, with US CPI next.
why: The dollar-yen rate is one of the most traded currency pairs and reflects the gap between US Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan policy.
why_moved: A soft US nonfarm payrolls report initially weakened the dollar, while rate-cut expectations later partly reversed. The yen remains driven by intervention risk and BoJ policy expectations.
